name: Dire Wolf

Actions.name: Bite
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

Actions.name: Rimecharge
Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw*: DC 13, one creature within 5 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Prone condition.

Traits.name: Rime-Crusted Hide
Traits.text: A creature that grapples the dire wolf or is Grappled by it takes 3 (1d6) Cold damage.

Traits.name: Pack Tactics
Traits.text: The dire wolf has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the dire wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

lore: A dire wolf that denned through one winter too many in the high passes comes back with a hide of frozen rime, and it hunts the passes now for warm blood to thaw its coat.
